## Acceptance Criteria

This bug is fixed when:

* [ ] The bug no longer occurs
* [ ] The expected behavior works correctly
* [ ] The fix has been tested or manually verified
* [ ] No unrelated behavior is broken
* [ ] A PR is opened and linked to this issue
